claim.claim-text: retrieving data representing a configuration data model for a plurality of network devices managed by a network management system; constructing a graph schema having a plurality of nodes, each of the nodes corresponding to one of the network devices according to the configuration data model storing data representing properties of the network devices associated with corresponding nodes of the graph schema according to the configuration data model; and outputting data identifying which of network devices corresponds to the nodes having a property matching at least one query property indicated in a graph schema query.

2. The method of claim 1, wherein the configuration data model is expressed in Yet Another Next Generation (YANG) data modeling language, and wherein the configuration data model comprises one of a low-level device configuration model, a service model, or an inventory model.

3. The method of any of claims 1 and 2, wherein the configuration data model includes one or more data structures including list data structures, leaf list data structures, container data structures, and container with presence data structures, wherein constructing the graph schema comprises constructing a GraphQL schema, wherein the plurality of nodes comprises a first plurality of nodes each corresponding to one of the network devices according to the configuration data model, and wherein constructing the GraphQL schema further comprises:

constructing a second set of nodes including list nodes, container nodes, and container with presence nodes corresponding to respective list data structures, container data structures, and container with presence data structures of the configuration data model, wherein constructing the second set of nodes comprises constructing one or more of the second set of nodes corresponding to the list data structures to include properties representing the leaf list data structures; and constructing a plurality of edges between the nodes in the GraphQL model, the edges including containment edges and reference edges.
4. The method of any of claims 1-3, wherein the graph schema query comprises data representing data model paths and at least one condition corresponding to the at least one query property.
5. The method of any of claims 1-4, further comprising generating a document database schema from the configuration data model.
6. The method of claim 5, wherein generating the document database schema comprises:

modeling a list with an entity extension of the configuration data model as a document of the document database schema; and setting properties of the document according to corresponding properties from the configuration data model.
7. The method of any of claims 5 and 6, wherein generating the document database schema comprises:

generating a parent vertex document corresponding to a parent vertex of the GraphQL model having a child vertex of the GraphQL model, wherein generating the parent vertex document comprises generating the parent vertex document to have a child property including an identifier for a child vertex document corresponding to the child vertex; and generating the child vertex document corresponding to the child vertex, wherein generating the child vertex document comprises generating the child vertex document to have a parent property including an identifier for the parent vertex document.

8. The method of any of claims 5-7, wherein determining which of the nodes has the property matching the at least one query property comprises using the document database schema to support one or more of sorting, searching, or filtering the GraphQL model to determine which of the nodes has the property matching the at least one query property.
9. A device comprising one or more means for performing the method of any of claims 1-8.
10. A computer-readable medium having stored thereon instructions that, when executed, cause one or more processors to perform the method of any of claims 1-8.
